news.title: Kimber Digital Securities Secures SEC Registration for Tokenized Stocks

news.title: Tokenization: The next evolution of the stock market

news.title: New joint venture looking to revive Robinhood

news.description: Charles Schwab has expanded its crypto trading platform by adding Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink, but XRP remains conspicuously absent despite the brokerage giant's aggressive push into digital assets.

news.description: Charles Schwab adds Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink trading, expanding Schwab Crypto to five assets with a 0.75% fee for eligible US buyers.

news.title: Aster DM Quality Care certifies fractional share payout for QCIL amalgamation
news.description: Aster DM Quality Care Limited certified the distribution of net proceeds from fractional shares to former Quality Care India Limited shareholders. The company sold 65 consolidated fractional shares at an average price of ₹676.0669 per share on October 8, 2026. Net sale proceeds of ₹43,834.43 were available for distribution after deducting brokerage and statutory charges. An amount of ₹1,886.45 relating to eight shareholders remains undistributed due to failed remittances and is held by the company.

news.title: Jensen Huang's affair rattles Nvidia stock: Shares drop nearly 4% in overnight trading
news.description: Nvidia shares fell about 3.7% on Robinhood's overnight platform after CEO Jensen Huang admitted an affair and the board launched a probe. Analysts flagged leadership risks ahead of earnings.

news.title: Splash Wallet Adds Support for Robinhood Chain

news.title: NYSE-backed crypto venture faces 90% stock rejection as $92 liquidity problem threatens tokenization dream

news.title: OpenWorld Brings Its Nasdaq-Listed Stock to Solana Through Sunrise and Backpack Securities
news.description: LAKE MARY, Fla., Nov. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- OpenWorld, Inc. (Nasdaq: OPNW) ('OpenWorld” or the 'Company”), a blockchain innovation company advancing real-world asset tokenization, today announced that its common stock is now available on Solana as tokenized OPNW. Issued by Backpack Securities and launched through Sunrise, the day one asset gateway of Solana made by Wormhole Labs, tokenized OPNW is now accessible across Solana’s markets.

news.title: TOP Financial Group Limited Addresses Recent Unusual Fluctuations in Stock Price
news.description: HOUSTON, Texas, Nov. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- TOP Financial Group Limited (NASDAQ: TOP, 'TOP” or the 'Company”), a fast-growing online brokerage firm specializing in local and foreign equities, futures, and options products, today issued a statement addressing the recent unusual fluctuations in its stock price and provided updates on its strategic business developments.
